summary: Require independent native coverage before acknowledging a collection cut

replay.detail: No replay or source backfill is introduced.

schema.detail: No schema or persistent state changes.

rules.detail: No admission, authority or checkpoint rules change.

compatibility.detail: Prepared collection adapters must supply an independent source coverage check, evaluated even when no keys changed. An uncovered cut cannot advance the delivered cursor. Existing wire formats and production adapter selection are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No startup work or daemon lifecycle change.

recovery.detail: No persistent recovery or binary swap restrictions change. Refused candidates preserve the delivered cursor for retry.
